$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-21-page-4d-c/2026-10-21-page-4d-c.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: Tie-break losers: record why each rule lost
decisions.recommendation: Approve. Spec 134:121 and the Phase 2 plan line 192 define it; the Layer 2 plan itself only points at them (plan line 56). Until it lands, dropped_by is stored as not_recorded (Phase 2 plan line 192).

decisions.question: Exception closure: a read-only list of the exceptions that apply to a lot
decisions.recommendation: Approve, as the plan recommends at line 165.

decisions.question: Scenario classes: define the building-type vectors
decisions.recommendation: Needs definition on one point. The plan says 'the three suite classes' (line 255) but then lists five classes (detached_house, detached_houseplex, semi_detached_houseplex, semi_detached_house, house_with_secondary_suite) and says garden and laneway are structures, so it does not say which three classes are new. Rule on the five-class list and which are new before the fix lane starts. The garden/laneway-as-structures reading is also OQ-7, which you answered in the Layer 2 page; the register row M-234 wording still needs your confirmation.

decisions.question: Exception chapters: zone letters to By-law 569-2013 Chapter 900 articles
decisions.recommendation: Approve. The plan defines it fully (line 327); the only content it names is the five-zone literal above, so the fix lane should confirm that list covers every in-scope residential zone.
